comparison.objective: Sort four paper sheets by color into matching trays.
comparison.physical_skill: Edge grasping thin sheets, separating a pile, sliding it to expose sheets, and flat placement.
comparison.success_condition: Each sheet is placed flat in its color-matched tray; no detailed damage or numeric rubric is provided.
comparison.reason: Sheet singulation and color sorting do not test coaxial mandrel alignment, impact fracture, retained-insert protection, or fragment recovery.
